All 3 tests pass.

**Fix**: `gridtools/io.py:13` — the loop bound was `range(0, len(edges) - 2)`, which built only `n-2` cells from `n` edges instead of the required `n-1`. Changed to `range(0, len(edges) - 1)`.

Root cause is a plain off-by-one in the loop bound, not specifically an odd/even parity issue — it dropped the last cell regardless of parity (verified against `tests/test_io.py`, which was already correctly encoding the n-1 cell invariant). No other code depends on `parse_grid`/`cell_widths` beyond this module and its tests, so no wider impact. Full suite (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`) passes: 3/3.
